files.reason: Look for the Rocq representation predicate that connects ownership of the backing limb array to a mathematical integer. The transferable interpretation is to decode the used prefix least-significant limb first, then apply the sign.

Check the Mini-GMP layout. Map _mp_d to d, _mp_alloc to dmax, and abs(_mp_size) to top. Mini-GMP encodes negativity in _mp_size, so the OpenSSL predicate must read neg separately and use the BN_ULONG limb radix.

Look for storage rules that expose the struct fields and distinguish ownership of the used prefix from storage for the spare capacity. OpenSSL flag-dependent ownership requires a separate justification.
